content.text: {"what_it_is": {"claims": [{"text": "Ground Based Strategic Deterrent EMD (program element 0605238F) is a U.S. Air Force engineering-and-manufacturing-development program funded in the Research, Development, Test and Evaluation, Air Force account.", "citation": {"fact_id": "b3dbb0faa2839359"}}, {"text": "The program has been designated the LGM-35A Sentinel and is modernizing the U.S. ground-based nuclear deterrent by replacing the aging Minuteman III intercontinental ballistic missile (ICBM) system.", "citation": {"fact_id": "ba76f92d4a5d0948"}}, {"text": "Sentinel is being developed in the Sentinel Systems Program Office of the Air Force's ICBM Systems Directorate, which will develop, produce, and deploy a fully integrated ICBM weapon system designed for enhanced safety, security, reliability, and effectiveness while lowering lifecycle costs.", "citation": {"fact_id": "ba76f92d4a5d0948"}}, {"text": "Key technical areas include Flight Systems — maturing the missile boosters, re-entry vehicle, and guidance systems that make up the aerospace vehicle equipment.", "citation": {"fact_id": "85f543dbb39f738c"}}, {"text": "The Command & Launch effort covers the design, development, integration, test, and certification of the secure communications and control systems needed to hold targets at risk.", "citation": {"fact_id": "bebd12c9736ba1c3"}}, {"text": "The Software effort owns and manages the complete Sentinel software baseline, architecture, and modularity to ensure seamless integration and interoperability across the weapon system.", "citation": {"fact_id": "28a9a98471443af0"}}, {"text": "The Test effort develops robust developmental, operational, and live-fire test capabilities across the weapon system's lifecycle to satisfy statutory and regulatory requirements and inform Operational Safety, Suitability, and Effectiveness determinations.", "citation": {"fact_id": "3b86233aace19608"}}]}, "why_it_matters": {"claims": [{"text": "The program's total funding more than doubles from $2,011,024 thousand (about $2.0 billion) in FY2025 to $4,147,563 thousand (about $4.1 billion) requested for FY2026.", "citation": {"fact_id": "2f6b057efa67b2df"}}, {"text": "That is a year-over-year increase of $2,136,539 thousand (about $2.1 billion) from FY2025 to FY2026.", "citation": {"fact_id": "125551cef5d41a39"}}, {"text": "In FY2024 the program recorded actual spending of $4,327,250 thousand (about $4.3 billion), so the FY2026 request roughly restores funding to its FY2024 level after a lower FY2025.", "citation": {"fact_id": "26651a7ff42b72b5"}}, {"text": "The FY2026 request splits into a discretionary request of $2,647,563 thousand (about $2.6 billion) and a reconciliation (mandatory) request of $1,500,000 thousand (about $1.5 billion).", "citation": {"fact_id": "894ed63e39df0927"}}, {"text": "The $1,500,000 thousand reconciliation request is additional mandatory funding on top of the discretionary base, together making up the program's $4,147,563 thousand FY2026 total.", "citation": {"fact_id": "38fa9a1f7e49a1de"}}, {"text": "The discretionary portion of the request flows through the single named Ground Based Strategic Deterrent (GBSD) project, funded at $2,647.563 million for the budget year.", "citation": {"fact_id": "7a88d70ded2b4c42"}}, {"text": "A Fiscal Receipts feed event flagged Ground Based Strategic Deterrent EMD as increasing 106% from FY2025 to FY2026, one of the larger year-over-year swings in the budget.", "citation": {"fact_id": "125551cef5d41a39"}}]}, "players": {"claims": [{"text": "The program is run by the U.S. Air Force, with funding drawn from the Research, Development, Test and Evaluation, Air Force appropriation.", "citation": {"fact_id": "894ed63e39df0927"}}, {"text": "Development is led by the Sentinel Systems Program Office within the Air Force's ICBM Systems Directorate, which also integrates the effort with the Minuteman III program office to manage the complex transition between the two ICBM systems.", "citation": {"fact_id": "ba76f92d4a5d0948"}}, {"text": "The Government Support effort funds the processes, governance, and program-management capabilities used to oversee contractor development and manage the program's major contracts.", "citation": {"fact_id": "cb5cffb46b7dee45"}}]}, "recent_developments": {"claims": []}}
